IIM Ahmedabad Updates MBA Admission Criteria for 2027 Intake

The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ahmedabad has revised its admission criteria for the MBA program for the 2027 intake, affecting the CAT 2026 shortlisting rules. Separately, 62 Armed Forces officers have commenced a corporate management program at IIM Ahmedabad, which utilizes a case-study-based teaching methodology.
